iron_steel.name: Iron & Steel
iron_steel.source_document: MoEFCC Draft Notification G.S.R. 517(E) - Iron & Steel GEI Targets (Revised Draft)
iron_steel.notes: Iron & Steel GEI targets are at REVISED DRAFT stage as of 21 Aug 2026. MoEFCC issued draft G.S.R. 517(E) on 26 June 2026 covering 255 units (JSW Steel, Tata Steel, SAIL, ArcelorMittal Nippon Steel, sponge-iron/ferro-alloy). Final notification pending public consultation closure. DO NOT treat as FINAL until gazette notification published. Re-verify before next release (see next_review_due).

fertiliser.notes: No finalised Fertiliser GEI notification found as of 21 Aug 2026. Remains in watchlist per broader nine-sector CCTS transition architecture. Policy integration with National Green Hydrogen Mission and Urea Subsidy Framework ongoing.
